patients and physicians contribute to delay in diagnosis of melanoma.

the average delay in the diagnosis of malignant melanomas is 12 months, and that 25% of the delay in the diagnosis is attributable to the patient and 75% is attributable to the physician.

there is a lot of room for improvement in melanoma detection.
